parallel.requirements: Recognized the Node.js ESM/no-dependency migration, exact argparse/json.loads behavior, Draft7Validator, check_schema, ErrorTree totals, and strict stdout formatting.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership while launching a workflow of keyword-family probe children plus a synthesis child; it also created parent-side tasks for JSON semantics, regex, validator core, CLI, and differential tests.
parallel.implementation: Wrote parser/value/regex/error modules, jsonschema formats/metaschemas/referencing/keywords/validators modules, argparse, and `/output/test18.mjs`, using parent-side probes and partial child findings.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Placed files under `/output`, but the first smoke run failed with a syntax error in `lib/py/pyregex.mjs`; the parent diagnosed U+2028 and wrote a repair script, with no evidence that it executed before timeout.
parallel.verification: Ran targeted executable probes and one smoke test of the generated port; the smoke test failed across cases before the run ended.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow synthesis was unfinished, several probe families failed, the repair loop was incomplete, process returncode was 143, and official evaluation completed at 0/60.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Py2JS, ESM, no-external-dependency, CLI, jsonschema Draft7, ErrorTree, and exact output requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single agent with workflows disabled; it probed the executable directly, built modules sequentially, and owned integration and testing locally.
serial.implementation: Wrote a JSON parser, argparse shim, jsonschema exception/type/utils/regex/format/keyword/referencing/metaschema/validator/index modules, and `/output/test18.mjs`.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Produced the expected entry point and local modules in `/output`; artifact validation found the expected files.
serial.verification: Ran targeted probes, a smoke command, and a 71-case differential harness that matched; then attempted a 1742-case generated differential run.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The large differential run exited 137 before completion, the agent process timed out, and official evaluation completed at 0/60 despite the visible 71-case pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the Draft7/ErrorTree, CLI, ESM, no dependency, and exact-output obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same obligations from the same prompt and executable probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition gap is visible; both tackled the same very broad jsonschema semantics.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into parent implementation tasks plus a large workflow of keyword-family probe children and a synthesis child.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial decomposed within one trajectory and kept all implementation, integration, and test ownership local.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added a multi-agent research/spec layer; serial used a single-owner implementation loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and family-specific, but several child results never completed and synthesis only received 7/11 family results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probe results in one context and directly used them to build the implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The difference is not a missing child brief; it is that the parallel workflow boundary failed to return a complete synthesized context before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote many `/output/lib` modules and an entry point, but the generated regex module contained a syntax-breaking U+2028 issue.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote an analogous module tree and entry point, then continued to differential testing without an immediate module parse failure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel hit an unresolved syntax repair loop; serial got further into end-to-end differential validation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow launched, some children completed, four failed with 429, two retried after stalls, and the synthesize child remained in progress when the workflow was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; local test results were immediately visible in the same trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried a failed/incomplete child result lifecycle that serial avoided.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent-owned writes produced the final files; no child merge collision is visible, but the integrated artifact failed to parse during smoke testing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Parent-owned serial writes produced the final files and passed the initial 71-case differential harness.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both used parent-owned final outputs; the visible integration gap in parallel is failed parse repair, not a write collision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran executable probes and a generated-port smoke test, but the smoke test failed before successful integrated verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran targeted probes, a smoke run, and a 71-case differential suite that matched before attempting a larger suite.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached stronger visible validation, while parallel closed with no successful generated-port verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent 2400 seconds and timed out; the workflow alone had 12 agents, 658404 child tokens, 199 tool calls, rate-limit failures, and unfinished synthesis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after 2399 seconds, but without delegation; its last visible action was a large 1742-case differential run killed with exit 137.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted wall-clock budget, but parallel’s exhaustion included a costly incomplete fan-out workflow whereas serial’s was local exhaustive testing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official status records are completed for both modes and both report solution_passed false with 0 of 60 samples passed, so the official outcome is concordant both_fail. The concrete task-solving difference is process depth rather than pass/fail: parallel spent a large budget on an incomplete child probing/synthesis workflow and timed out while still repairing a syntax failure; serial kept work local, reached a 71-case differential pass, then timed out during a larger 1742-case run. Neither delivered an officially passing port.
parallel_contributors: Broad child probe workflow consumed budget and did not return a final synthesized spec before timeout.
Visible generated-port smoke test failed with a syntax error and the repair was not completed.
serial_contributors: Single-agent local probing and implementation reached a 71-case differential pass.
Large generated differential run exited 137 near timeout and official evaluation still failed 0/60.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel generated a syntax-breaking U+2028 issue in the regex module; serial avoided that visible parse failure but still did not pass official tests.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel-side adverse process consequence, not an explanation for discordant official results

retained_patterns.reason: A broad parallel keyword-probing workflow ran 12 agents, retried stalled probes, hit four 429 failures, consumed substantial child tokens/tool calls, and remained killed with synthesis incomplete while the parent timed out before repair/verification finished.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel run lost final synthesis and final verification time; it closed timed out with the repair script only written and an unresolved generated-port parse failure.
